integrity: Analytic section-volume, exact beta mixture, Poisson-gamma weak limit and moment arguments with finite arithmetic checks; no independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Axis-aligned, concentric horizontal cube and crosspolytope separated by unit height with fixed positive radius ratio as dimension tends to infinity; no dimension-varying ratio theorem. An equivalent historical limit law is possible.
title: A Poisson–gamma height law for cube–crosspolytope Cayley bodies
